claims: The Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) is an annual, multi-day gathering of conservative activists, politicians, and media personalities.
CPAC is typically hosted by the American Conservative Union.
CPAC brings together grassroots activists, elected officials, and thought leaders for networking, speeches, and training sessions.
As of late March 2026, the 2026 CPAC event was held in Grapevine, Texas.
There are other entities with similar acronyms, such as Commercial Property Assessed Clean Energy (C-PACE) financing.
